from docx import Document

paragraphs = [p.text for p in doc.paragraphs if p.text.strip()]

# Build PDF
pdf = SimpleDocTemplate(
    "/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf",
    pagesize=letter,
    topMargin=0.6*inch, bottomMargin=0.6*inch,
    leftMargin=0.7*inch, rightMargin=0.7*inch
)

styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
title_style = ParagraphStyle('CTitle', parent=styles['Title'], fontSize=18, spaceAfter=16, alignment=TA_CENTER)
name_style = ParagraphStyle('CName', parent=styles['Heading2'], fontSize=14, spaceAfter=6, textColor=colors.HexColor('#2E4057'))
normal_style = ParagraphStyle('CNormal', parent=styles['Normal'], fontSize=10, spaceAfter=4, leading=14)
item_style = ParagraphStyle('CItem', parent=styles['Normal'], fontSize=9, spaceAfter=3, leftIndent=20, leading=12, textColor=colors.HexColor('#555555'))

elements = []

for p_text in paragraphs:
    if p_text == "Customer Activity Report":
        elements.append(Paragraph(p_text, title_style))
        elements.append(Spacer(1, 10))
    elif not p_text.startswith("  ") and not p_text.startswith("Order ") and not p_text.startswith("Email:") and "|" not in p_text:
        # Customer name
        elements.append(Spacer(1, 12))
        elements.append(Paragraph(p_text, name_style))
    elif p_text.strip().startswith("Items:"):
        safe = p_text.strip().replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")
        elements.append(Paragraph(safe, item_style))
    else:
        safe = p_text.strip().replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")
        # Replace em-dash for safety
        safe = safe.replace("\u2014", "-")
        elements.append(Paragraph(safe, normal_style))

pdf.build(elements)
print("PDF created at /workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
'''
